trust_decision.summary: A caller-supplied vault_dir is passed straight to path.resolve() and then fs.mkdir({recursive:true}) plus two fs.writeFile calls, and a second caller-controlled component (slug_prefix) is interpolated straight into the {slug}.md / {slug}.json filename, so any MCP or HTTP caller can create directories and write files anywhere the server process can write; the published fix decides containment in src/utils/vault-writer.ts (new resolveVaultDir for the directory, new sanitizeSlugPrefix inside makeSlug for the filename) and only enforces it when the NOTEBOOKLM_VAULT_ROOT env var is set at call time.

landing_point.why: The summary names vault.batch writing outside an intended vault directory; the first and only directory handling in that flow is `const absVaultDir = path.resolve(vault_dir);` immediately followed by `fs.mkdir(absVaultDir, { recursive: true })`, in the one helper both the MCP tool and the HTTP route call.

fix_sites.entry_point: runBatchToVault directory resolution — reached by MCP tool batch_to_vault / vault_batch (src/index.ts:403 -> src/tools/index.ts:1820) and HTTP POST /batch-to-vault (src/http-wrapper.ts:157)
same two entry points; the slug_prefix argument reaches makeSlug and becomes the {slug}.md / {slug}.json filename component
MCP tool schema and description for batch_to_vault (vault_dir property text)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: download_content's output_path is documented as an explicit 'Optional local path to save the file' the caller chose, there is no vault-root notion on that path, so a solver can argue that saving exactly where it was told is the feature and not the traversal this advisory is about.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Backward compatibility of absolute vault_dir values: with NOTEBOOKLM_VAULT_ROOT unset any absolute path must still be written to (CHANGELOG keeps 'existing users see no behaviour change'), and with the var set an absolute path that legitimately lives inside the root must still be accepted. Users are documented passing absolute paths like /path/to/your/vault/cnv, so an over-broad fix that rejects absolute paths or confines everything to cwd breaks real deployments.

O6_input_shapes: absolute vault_dir outside the configured root (rejected)
absolute vault_dir inside the configured root (accepted)
relative vault_dir resolved against the root (accepted)
sibling directory sharing the root's name prefix, e.g. <root>-evil (rejected)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second writer in the same helper that emits a batch index/manifest (INDEX.md, .jsonl answer cache) under vault_dir using a caller-supplied or caller-prefixed name
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the tool already produces a sidecar per answer and returns per-question paths for RTFM/markdown-vault ingestion, so an index or cache writer is the natural next commit and would need the same containment.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the project already supports DATA_DIR for multi-instance data and a full multi-account config surface, so a configurable vault root default fits the existing pattern.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the REST layer already re-exposes 33 capabilities and the stdio proxy forwards only a subset of tools, so a vault-specific route added for n8n/Zapier users is plausible.

unverified: repo_mb could not be measured without shell access; src/ is ~58 .ts files with no large binary assets (website images are SVGs plus one small JPEG), so total source is almost certainly under 5 MB and tiny_repo is flagged on that basis.

The O8 routes' link to this advisory is arguable: they write to a caller-named file rather than escaping a vault root, and both download sinks (src/content/content-manager.ts:3204, :3551) require a live Playwright download from NotebookLM, so they cannot be exercised offline without a mocked page/download event — they are recorded as uncovered routes, not as offline-testable ones.
present_in_latest is unknown for all three O8 routes because no latest release/code was supplied ('none').

The published fix's containment is lexical (path.resolve + path.relative at fix.diff:4194-4202, no realpath), so a symlink inside NOTEBOOKLM_VAULT_ROOT still escapes; this is a HOW-type weakness of the fix itself, not verified by running anything.

Whether the project's own jest suite can drive ContentManager.downloadContent offline is unverified; the existing downloadAudio test at src/__tests__/content-manager.test.ts:243-252 asserts only that a result is defined.
